How to buy avocado night cream online, step by step

We take orders on WhatsApp so a real person can answer questions before you pay. It usually takes a couple of minutes.

  1. Message us on WhatsApp at +91 99808 81230 with the cream name and how many jars you want.
  2. Share your delivery details: name, full address with PIN code, and a phone number the courier can reach.
  3. Choose how to pay: Cash on Delivery, or an online payment link that we send you.
  4. We confirm the order and pack it. Orders are shipped from Bhatkal, Karnataka.
  5. Track it. Once it's shipped you get tracking details, and you can also check on the track order page.
  6. Delivery usually takes 3 to 7 days, a little longer for remote PIN codes or during the Diwali and wedding rush. Shipping is free across India. The shipping policy has the details.

Cash on delivery or a payment link?

Both work the same way for the cream itself. Cash on Delivery suits you if it's your first order with us and you'd rather pay when the parcel is in your hand. Just keep the exact amount ready, because couriers often don't carry change.

A payment link suits you if you won't be home, or someone else will receive the parcel at the office or a hostel gate. You pay through the link, and nobody has to hand over cash at the door. Either way, the price is the one we confirm on WhatsApp, with no extra shipping charge.

Making sure you get a genuine jar

Popular creams get copied, and avocado creams are no exception. Copies tend to appear on random social media pages, in loose unlabelled tubs, or at prices that look too good. The safest route is to buy directly from us.

A genuine jar comes sealed, with a batch number, manufacturing and expiry dates, an ingredient list, MRP and our details on the pack. If something doesn't look right, send us a photo of the batch number on WhatsApp and we'll check it. Our full checklist is in avocado night cream original vs fake.

What to check when the parcel arrives

  • The outer box isn't crushed or opened.
  • The jar's seal is intact. Don't break it until you've checked everything else.
  • The product name and size match what you ordered.
  • The batch number and expiry date are printed and readable.
  • If anything is wrong, message us before opening the jar. Returns are accepted on sealed jars within 7 days; see returns and refunds.

Then do a patch test before putting it on your face. Apply a little on the side of your neck or behind the ear once a day for two or three days. Mild warmth that fades is usually fine. Itching, redness or bumps mean stop. Our avocado night cream side effects guide explains what's normal and what isn't.

What an avocado night cream can't do

We'd rather you buy with the right expectations. A night cream helps skin feel moisturised and soft, often from the first week. With steady nightly use and sunscreen every morning, the kojic acid and niacinamide jars can help skin look more even, but that takes time. Skin renews roughly every 4 to 6 weeks, so think 8 to 12 weeks, not days.

It won't change your natural skin colour. It isn't a fix for melasma, painful or cystic acne, eczema or rashes, and those deserve a dermatologist's visit. If you're pregnant, check with your doctor before using a cream with kojic acid.

Who should skip ordering right now: if your skin is currently irritated, peeling or reacting to something else, wait until it settles. If you just want something very gentle, the 15 g Glow Cream is the better buy over the kojic acid jars.

Short answers

Can I buy avocado night cream online with cash on delivery? Yes. Order on WhatsApp and choose Cash on Delivery, or pay through an online payment link if you prefer.

Is shipping free? Yes, across India. Delivery usually takes 3 to 7 days.

Can I return it? Sealed jars can be returned within 7 days. Opened jars can't, so check the parcel before breaking the seal.

Which jar should I buy first? The Avocado Korean Night Cream for most skin, the 30 g Avocado Night Cream for dry skin, or the 15 g Glow Cream if your skin is sensitive.

How do I know the jar is genuine? Buy from us directly, check the seal and batch number, and send us a photo on WhatsApp if you're unsure.

This is general skincare information, not medical advice. Patch test any new product, and see a dermatologist if you have a skin condition.
